symptom: In Combined Operation of Swing and Boom Raise, Boom Rise Speed is Low
detail_of_failure: In combined operation of swing and boom RAISE, boom RAISE speed is low.
related_information: Pre-troubleshooting If the operation is slow even in boom RAISE only, do the troubleshooting for “Boom Speed or Power is Low” in H mode first.

steps.cause: LS select valve of swing control valve
steps.procedure: 1. Examine the LS select valve of swing control valve. 2. Is the valve operation and seal correct?

branches.YES: • LS select valve of swing control valve is normal. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • LS select valve of swing control valve is defective. • Clean or replace the check valve seat of the LS select valve of the swing control valve. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: 1. Stop the engine. 2. Connect all the component parts. 3. Start the engine to do the troubleshooting. 4. Does the boom operate correctly?

branches.NO: Go back to the first check item.
